title: Topic 11: Shopping - Speaking
description: Recorded speaking task, teacher-graded against a 4-criterion rubric.
canDoStatement: Buy things, ask prices, sizes, quantities

speakingTask.speakingPrompt:
Record yourself. You are in a shop. Play BOTH voices
(assistant and you) - like a mini theater!
Include:
1. Assistant: Can I help you?
2. You: ask the price of one NEAR thing (this/these)
and one FAR thing (that/those)
3. Assistant: give two prices
4. You: choose one, ask for it politely (Can I have...),
and say card or cash

Tip: Change your voice a little for each speaker - fun

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_topic11_shopping.txt, Lesson 11.4. XP 15 on submit, +10 on approval.

criteria.title: Polite request with Can I + please
